## archive

Archive a prompt

```bash
cn archive <name>
```

**Arguments:**

| Name | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | yes | Prompt name |

## completions

Generate shell completions

```bash
cn completions <shell>
```

**Arguments:**

| Name | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `shell` | yes | Shell to generate completions for (bash, zsh, fish) |

## config

Read, write, and inspect .canopy/config.yaml

```bash
cn config
```

## create

Create a new prompt

```bash
cn create [options]
```

**Options:**

| Flags | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--name <name>` | Prompt name |
| `--description <text>` | Short description |
| `--extends <name>` | Inherit from parent prompt |
| `--mixin <name>` | Add mixin prompt (repeatable) |
| `--tag <tag>` | Add tag (repeatable) |
| `--schema <name>` | Assign validation schema |
| `--emit-as <filename>` | Custom emit filename |
| `--emit-dir <path>` | Custom emit directory |
| `--status <status>` | Initial status (draft\|active) |
| `--section <name=body>` | Add section (name=body shorthand, repeatable) |
| `--fm <key=value>` | Set frontmatter field (repeatable) |

## diff

Section-aware diff between two prompt versions

```bash
cn diff <name> <v1> <v2>
```

**Arguments:**

| Name | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | yes | Prompt name |
| `v1` | yes | First version number |
| `v2` | yes | Second version number |


**Options:**

## emit

Render and write prompt to a file

```bash
cn emit [name] [options]
```

**Arguments:**

| Name | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | no |  |

**Options:**

| Flags | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--all` | Emit all active prompts |
| `--check` | Check if emitted files are up to date |
| `--out <path>` | Custom output path (single prompt) |
| `--out-dir <path>` | Custom output directory (--all mode) |
| `--force` | Overwrite even if unchanged |
| `--dry-run` | Show what would be emitted |

## update

Update a prompt (creates new version)

```bash
cn update <name> [options]
```

**Arguments:**

| Name | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | yes | Prompt name |

**Options:**

| Flags | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--name <name>` | Rename prompt |
| `--description <text>` | Update description |
| `--section <name>` | Section to update (use with --body or name=body shorthand) |
| `--body <text>` | New body for the section specified by --section |
| `--add-section <name>` | Add a new section (use name=body shorthand, repeatable) |
| `--remove-section <name>` | Remove a section (sets body to empty, repeatable) |
| `--tag <tag>` | Add tag (repeatable) |
| `--untag <tag>` | Remove tag (repeatable) |
| `--schema <name>` | Assign schema |
| `--extends <name>` | Change parent prompt |
| `--mixin <name>` | Add mixin (repeatable) |
| `--remove-mixin <name>` | Remove mixin (repeatable) |
| `--emit-as <filename>` | Custom emit filename |
| `--emit-dir <path>` | Custom emit directory |
| `--status <status>` | Change status (draft\|active\|archived) |
| `--fm <key=value>` | Set frontmatter field (repeatable) |
| `--remove-fm <key>` | Remove frontmatter field (repeatable) |
